{{Top|leg}}
'''Director of Administration''' was a title given to the head of the administrative branch of the [[Colonial Government]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Crela Nen]] held the post.
